audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 row read 'Skill' in both layers while the packet chart, both narratives (whys[4], spikes[2], mid) and the mirror audit all say Ambessa owns level 6.
audit.why: The mirror left this unfixed believing 'Skill'->'Ambessa' would fail the length band; side/rating are enum fields and are exempt, so the flip applies cleanly.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] both flipped to Ambessa as a pair, with phases[4].rating dropped from 6/10 to 4/10 to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere; spikes were labelled only by level.
audit.why: Cunning Sweep 14s at rank 1, Repudiation 18s, Public Execution 130s and Poppy's own W at 20s are what actually define the windows.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1], whys[4] and spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page is built around 'Repeating Dashes', which is not an Ambessa ability. Her mobility is Drakehound's Step (P), triggered by an attack or movement command during any cast. The Repudiation shield and the Public Execution suppression were never named, so the two interactions that decide the fight were absent.
audit.why: Riot's text: P dashes after a cast and refunds energy; W shields, braces, and deals more if it blocked non-minion damage; R blinks, suppresses on arrival, then slams and stuns. Suppression on Public Execution cancels Keeper's Verdict, so the channel is only safe once her R is spent. Steadfast Presence does stop the passive dash — that part was right and is now stated with its consequence (ground plus slow).
audit.corrected: Fabricated name replaced with Drakehound's Step; Repudiation named as the shield to bait; Public Execution named as the suppress that eats your channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization and the late-game block both prescribed anti-heal 'because his healing fights your grind'.
audit.why: Ambessa has no healing in Riot's text. The kit file's 'heal' flag on Public Execution is a parser misfire on 'slams the ground' — the mirror audit flagged the same thing. Buying Grievous Wounds here is wasted gold.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal advice replaced with armour timing against her repeated Drakehound's Step re-entries.

edits.after: Ambessa wins by chaining Drakehound's Step onto you and landing Public Execution's suppress-stun.

edits.before: Keep pressing the same pattern — W denies her engage, E into terrain stuns, Q chips her low health bars. The one window to respect is level 6: her ult chain-CC plus W damage is real burst, and your R is peel/displacement, not damage, so you can't trade burst-for-burst there. Hold W for her ult-combo and don't get caught mid-screen away from a wall.
edits.after: Keep pressing the same pattern — W denies her engage, E into terrain stuns, Q chips her low health bars. The window to respect is level 6: Public Execution suppresses you on arrival, so it cancels Keeper's Verdict outright — never channel while her 130s R is up. Hold W for her ult-combo and don't get caught mid-screen away from a wall.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' is a fabricated ability name — Ambessa's mobility is the passive Drakehound's Step. It survives in focus.text ('Ambessa Repeating Dashes', 24 chars) and in several boilerplate strings that only repeat it; the applier skips strings under 25 characters, so focus.text needs a manual fix. Confirming the mirror's kit-file warning: the 'heal' and 'grounding' flags on Public Execution and the 'grounding' flag on Repudiation are not supported by Riot's text and I made no claim from them — I also removed the anti-heal item advice they had produced.
